decision: Conservative fault-policy revision before promotion; original freeze/result remain immutable.
fault_acceptance: Reject every invalid or changed receipt; no false done/custody or accepted-byte changes. Match old preexisting-done fault durable output. revised_hypothesis: Capture existing done pointers before discovery. Validate absent done pointers before writes. Freshly validate each discovered receipt at its existing upsert point. If that validator fails for a previously-done pointer, rollback this recovery transaction, whose prior work was committed by the unchanged ensure_queue setup. Preserve validated-prefix pending work for newly discovered faults and the old upsert-error behavior.
